### ✨ New Features

* disable DeLonghi permission prompts ([cbb67de](https://github.com/NekoGryphou/gryphous-morphe-patches/commit/cbb67de1cee4e03741758936f4a912812ee4f3dc))

patches.name: Enable Picture-in-Picture
patches.description: Enables automatic Android Picture-in-Picture when leaving Crunchyroll playback.

patches.name: Disable login location requirement
patches.description: Allows login and registration without granting location permission.

patches.name: Disable notification permission prompt
patches.description: Prevents De'Longhi Comfort from asking to enable notifications.

patches.name: Hide shared-devices incident popup
patches.description: Prevents the GetReceivedShares-003 incident popup from appearing.
